items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: Lawrence, Lawrence Stoker used to play trumpet. He was a bass player. And the bass player, anybody play bass? ... Ike Graveson. He used to play trombone. Did you have a trumpet in that band?

ctx.x: Yeah, oh, Lawrence Stoker used to play trumpet.
Oh, yeah. Yeah. Lawrence, Lawrence Stoker used to play trumpet. Oh, yeah.
